spiritual_reading.full_translation:
Attend to the first directed influx that proceeded from the Divine Life at the beginning. The Divine sent it into the good that first engages directly with evil. It was an impartation of concord and conjunction, flowing from love into the will as a salutation of unity to what was akin within the same order; and within that influx was contained, in full comprehensiveness, the whole disclosure of what was to be brought into effect, together with the entire arrangement of the uses it would establish through that influx. By that influx, the first good was set into its appointed course, and the whole process that must follow from it was determined.

In return, the responsive perception proceeding from that first good ascended into a more interior and elevated awareness, and so came back to the Divine Life. This, too, was a reciprocal communication, flowing from the engaged good back toward its source, and within it was comprehended the full disclosure of the state: every assault, every conflict, and every temptation that had been endured in opposing what was contrary. It carried the whole series in order—everything that had taken place in act, everything that was to take place in continuation, what had already been effected, and what was now disposed and prepared to be effected through that same good. Therefore the Divine Life, from its own omniscience and immediate presence, perceived completely all the oppositions, perils, and contests that the governing falsities had raised against that first good.

spiritual_reading.overall_coherence: Coherent as a two-step spiritual process: a first directed influx that contains an entire program of uses, followed by a reciprocal return that discloses the full temptation-series. The only instability is due to the source’s damaged phrasing and bracketed gaps, not to the spiritual thread itself.

findings.diagnosis: Clean, coherent correspondential substrate teaching in epistolary form: a two-step process (summons → response) where the spiritual sense arises from what the ‘letters’ DO (convey peace/program; report conflicts/state), not from jurisdictional listings or ranked administrations. The only stumble is physical damage/lacuna at the end of ¶2, not a voice-conflict.
findings.evidence:
Text: “Consider the summons, which was sent from the Living Spirit… It is a peace letter and greeting… in which all the tidings are written down, together with everything it will bring about and establish…” This teaches by function: the summons/letter functions as initiating communication containing a whole operative ‘program’ (tidings + what it brings about/establishes). The spiritual reading tracks this naturally (“first directed influx… contained… the whole disclosure… arrangement of the uses it would establish”).
Text: “The answer… is also a letter… in which all the tidings are written down; and every war and the struggles… everything that had happened and everything [that would happen]…” Again functional: the response/answer functions as a complete state-report of conflict and what is prepared to occur; the reading mirrors this (“reciprocal communication… full disclosure of the state: every assault, every conflict…”).
No administrative markers appear (no ranks, stations, territorial authorities, inventories). Named figures (Living Spirit, First Man) are not a bureaucratic list but the minimal actors required by the functional exchange.
The reading itself reports no narrative break: “Coherent as a two-step spiritual process… The only instability is due to… damaged phrasing and bracketed gaps.” That is consistent with a damaged ending rather than insertion.

findings.diagnosis: Genuine difficulty from damaged/fragmentary text (lacuna) that forces interpretive smoothing; not evidence of later administrative insertion or seam-expansion.
findings.evidence: Text ends: “That summons, the First Man [... is ordained to happen.” This is syntactically broken and incomplete, and the spiritual reading explicitly notes: “The end of the paragraph is textually broken in the source; the closure… is rendered as determination of the ensuing process.” Removing anything will not improve coherence; the problem is missing words, not mismatched teaching mode.

findings.diagnosis: Genuine difficulty from editorial supplementation/restoration brackets; the passage remains internally consistent and correspondential, but the brackets indicate uncertainty about exact wording.
findings.evidence: Text includes restorations/clarifications: “It did [not only report]… the First Man [was recounting]… everything [that would happen]…” The spiritual reading notes this explicitly: “The source contains bracketed lacunae and clarifying insertions; these are smoothed into a continuous spiritual report…” This is a textual condition issue (reconstruction), not an intrusive administrative overlay: the content stays on ‘reporting tidings/war/struggles’ and the Living Spirit’s knowing/perceiving.

textual_criticism.summary: No administrative-layer insertions detected. 3 findings total: (1) confirmation of a clean correspondential two-step narrative (summons → answer); (2) one genuine difficulty from a lacuna at the end of ¶2; (3) one genuine difficulty from bracketed restorations in ¶3. Recommendations: excise 0; annotate 0; none 3.

harmonized_paragraphs.text: Consider the summons, which was sent from the Living Spirit in the beginning. He sent it to the First Man. It is a peace letter and greeting that he wrote and sent to his brother, in which all the tidings are written down, together with everything it will bring about and establish by that summons. That summons, the First Man [... is ordained to happen.

⟨p.183⟩
The answer that was sent from the First Man came to the heights, to the Living Spirit. That is also a letter, which was sent from the First Man to the Living Spirit, in which all the tidings are written down; and every war and the struggles that he had waged. It did [not only report] in the answer that the First Man [was recounting] everything that had happened and everything [that would happen], all that had been done and whatever is made ready to be done by him. The Living Spirit knew all the wars and the dangers and the contests that the rulers had waged against the First Man.

changes_summary: No changes made. All findings (Finding 1, Finding 2, Finding 3) carried recommendation: none; therefore no excisions were executed.
